name: Floor is Lava for Brainrots!
desc:
Welcome to Floor is Lava for Brainrots! 🔥

Run fast and collect Brainrots! 🏃‍♂️
The floor turns into lava so don’t fall in! 🌋
Jump on platforms and bring your Brainrots back to your base! ⚠️

Upgrade your Brainrots to earn more cash 💸
Upgrade your base to unlock more slots 🏗️
Train your speed with treadmills ⚡

Your Brainrots earn cash even while offline 💤

Like the game and join the group for a FREE Brainrot 👍🎁
